project_context.app_type: Single HTML SPA (Vanilla JS + inline CSS)
project_context.constraint: Zero-Egress. No external CDNs, no external fonts, no external images. No frameworks (No React/Tailwind).

design_direction.visual_mood: High contrast, structural grayscale, terminal-like precision

rules: Never use pure black for cards, only for the deepest background.
Use #27272A for all grid borders to create a technical wireframe look.
Do not use any gradients. Only solid, flat colors.

font_stacks.heading: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
font_stacks.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

rules: Overlines/Labels (like 'PROJEKT DATEIEN') MUST be uppercase, 11px, letter-spacing: 0.1em.
Metrics and hex hashes MUST use the mono font.

landing_page: Remove generic centering. Align the hero text to the left.
Use a strict 2-column or 3-column CSS Grid for the 'Why Better' section with sharp 1px borders.
The login form should look like a highly secure, minimalist terminal block.
hud_dashboard: Use a dense CSS grid (Bento style). Left panel: 280px, Center: 1fr, Right: 350px.
Remove all gaps and use border-collapse style layouts: panels touch each other separated only by 1px borders.

buttons.secondary: Background transparent, Border #27272A, Text #FAFAFA. Hover: Border #FFFFFF.

cards_and_panels.style: Flat solid surfaces (#09090B). No glassmorphism. No soft drop shadows.

file_tree.style: Tight vertical spacing. Hover state changes background to #18181B. Active state has a 2px left border of #FFFFFF.

findings_list.style: Look like terminal output logs. Left border indicator for severity. Background slightly tinted with the severity color at 5% opacity.

rules: CRITICAL: Remove all emojis from HTML. They look unprofessional.
Replace emojis (⚡, 🔒, 🎯, 📊, 🏆, 🌐, 📁, 📄, 🎨, {}) with pure inline <svg> elements.
SVGs should use stroke='currentColor', stroke-width='1.5', fill='none', stroke-linecap='round', stroke-linejoin='round'.
The 3D Phase Space canvas should be updated to use the new color palette (Emerald, Amber, Red) against the dark background.
All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Your objective is to drastically improve the frontend professionalism of /app/src/assets/index.html and /app/src/assets/code_auditor.html.
Both files currently have identical content; apply the redesign to BOTH files.
You MUST use Vanilla JS and inline CSS ONLY. Do not install Tailwind, React, or any other framework.
Apply the CSS variables defined in this guideline.
Refactor the DOM structure where necessary to achieve the 'Swiss Brutalist' layout.
Replace EVERY emoji with an inline SVG string.
Ensure all existing JS logic (Phase Space animation, File analysis, Authentication) remains intact and functional.

Start the app using `python3 -m http.server 8000 --directory /app/src/assets &` and test the auditor using `curl` or by writing a basic test script or using browser tools to fulfill the 'auditor testen' requirement.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Create depth through sharp contrast and strict grids, not muddy gradients.
Do not center-align the app container.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters. Use standard SVGs.
All interactive elements must include a data-testid attribute.
